info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Development Environment Management API
info.description: This API allows for the management and configuration of the development environment within the IT management banking system. It supports operations to adjust settings and parameters to optimize the development workflows. Typical users include developers and IT administrators who need to ensure that the development environment aligns with project requirements. By enabling dynamic updates, this API facilitates agile practices and enhances collaboration among team members.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update specific attributes of a development environment resource identified by its unique identifier (RES-100045). Ensure to provide the correct data format and attributes for the update to succeed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the specified development environment resource identified by RES-100045. The request should contain the necessary fields to make updates, as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and resource updated.
